Regularly clean the Active Power Filter, especially the slits, openings, and filters, to ensure that the air freely flows into the Active Power

regularly to avoid any object from blocking or covering these areas.

answers.text: The excerpt states only that a red fault indicator means the module is malfunctioning; it does not identify an Active Power Filter module or state an AFFECTS relationship.
answers.rationale: The LED description reports the module’s status but does not establish that the malfunctioning module is an Active Power Filter module or that this failure mode affects that component.
The Ambient OTP row lists blocked air vents as a possible fault, supporting the stated airflow-obstruction failure mode affecting the air vents.
